statement: consecutive_groups accepts a step argument; with step=2, [2, 4, 6, 10, 12] is grouped into [2, 4, 6] and [10, 12].
Negative steps group descending runs: step=-1 on [9, 8, 7, 3, 2] gives [9, 8, 7] and [3, 2].
